name: Dangerous Danny
author: Addicting Games
description: Dangerous Danny is a free-avoider game. Dangerous Danny is on a daring dive to the deepest depths and it's your job to keep him safe and make him rich. Dangerous Danny is an avoider game where you must help Danny traverse the depths in order to collect sunken treasure, but beware! For within the waters of the world there are threats the likes of which you could never imagine. Help Danny dodge octopi, blood-thirsty crabs, sharks, and even the occasional starfish. When diving seems out of the question there is also your trusty harpoon gun. The harpoon gun has limited ammo though, so, you're going to want to keep that thing fully loaded and ready to go just in case you find yourself in some weird situations. It won't be easy but diving into the great unknown will be fun with Dangerous Danny the daring diver who isn't scared of anything.
